propositions: At search exhaustion with insufficient evidence found, completion verifier banks met=false incorrectly as evidence-of-absence rather than distinguishing absence-of-evidence, producing false FAIL verdicts on criteria whose evidence exists but was not reached within the search window.

The bounded fallback banking path must carry a tri-state marker (met, refuted, insufficient) to signal exhaustion-without-determination separately from positive refutation, enabling framework to derive correct remediation and prevent misattribution of budget limits as proof of non-compliance.

Marker ownership and preservation rules: evidence_sufficient:false written only by framework at bounded-fallback boundary; model-facing tool stays bool-only; harvest preserve-on-overwrite keeps prior marker when replaced by bare met=false; genuine refutation (bare met=false from refutation path) clears marker.

All consumer paths must validate, propagate, and render the marker consistently: schema accepts optional markers; verdict assembly and placeholder branches carry it; rendering distinguishes insufficient-evidence refusals from unmet-criteria guidance; sidecar FAIL payload round-trips both levels; close gate reports sufficient vs refutation distinction.

Audit ticket page (shape-based PASS/FAIL discriminator) was missing from consumer graph and broken by deliberate addition of criteria to FAIL payload; fix keyed on actual verdict value not presence of criteria field, restoring findings rendering for FAIL records with markers.
